disclaimer.en: This report was automatically executed and generated by the DeepGuard Audit Agent. Security auditing has inherent limitations: static analysis cannot cover all runtime behavior, dynamic observation cannot exhaust all trigger paths, and AI-based semantic judgment may produce false negatives and false positives. A "not detected" conclusion in this report only means that no malicious behavior or security risk was found within the current ruleset version, detection depth, and time window; it does not constitute any guarantee that the plugin is absolutely safe or free of malicious behavior now or in the future. Detected items may also deviate due to contextual differences. This report covers only the plugin version and commit snapshot it identifies; any new version released by the author afterwards, or any rewrite of an existing version (including force-push), is outside its scope. Installing and using a plugin is the user's own decision, and the associated risks are assessed and borne by the user. DeepGuard reserves the right to re-audit historical versions and revise conclusions as the ruleset evolves.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件解析与使用的全部凭据读取面：DeepSeek 余额 Key、OpenCode Go Key、9 家 Coding Plan 厂商 Key（含火山方舟 AK/SK）、自定义余额请求头变量与网关管理密钥。每把 Key 只发往对应厂商的硬编码官方端点，DeepSeek 余额查询保留仅官方域名的端点守卫（lib/index.js:859-869），非官方地址直接拒绝发请求。
checked_items.en: Examined all credential-read surfaces parsed and used by the plugin: the DeepSeek balance Key, OpenCode Go Key, Keys for 9 Coding Plan vendors (including Volcano Ark AK/SK), custom balance request-header variables, and the gateway admin secret. Each Key is sent only to its vendor's hardcoded official endpoint; the DeepSeek balance query retains an endpoint guard restricted to the official domain (lib/index.js:859-869), and requests to non-official addresses are rejected outright.

checked_items.zh: 检查了密钥写入与托管路径：前端输入的密钥经 setCredential 单向写入宿主凭据库并随即清空 config 遗留明文（lib/index.js:1925-1933），启动期迁移把账本遗留明文导入凭据库（lib/index.js:2403-2468）；读取侧只返回「已配置（来源）」状态、不返回值本身。预扫命中的凭据写入代码（DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 @ lib/index.js:1925,2188,2252,2432 与 CHANGELOG.md:288）即上述托管机制与变更日志描述文字，用户输入值只进凭据库、不落盘不回显，良性排除。
checked_items.en: Examined secret storage and escrow paths: keys entered in the frontend are written one-way via setCredential into the host credential store, and leftover plaintext in config is cleared immediately afterward (lib/index.js:1925-1933); a startup migration imports ledger-leftover plaintext into the credential store (lib/index.js:2403-2468); the read side returns only a 'configured (source)' status and never the value itself. The credential-writing code hit in the prescan (DSH-X05/DG-R3-57 @ lib/index.js:1925,2188,2252,2432 and CHANGELOG.md:288) is exactly the escrow mechanism and change-log descriptive text above; user-entered values only go into the credential store, never written to disk or echoed back — benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了源码树内是否存在硬编码密钥或令牌明文，未发现；仓库文档仅记录令牌存放位置的指针（维护者本机环境变量），无任何令牌值。
checked_items.en: Checked the source tree for hardcoded secret or token plaintext: none found. Repository documentation only contains pointers to where tokens are stored (maintainer's local environment variables), with no token values.

evidence.zh: 凭据读取面核查：多把 API Key / Token 只发往各家硬编码官方端点（lib/index.js:859-869 的余额端点守卫、lib/coding-plans.js:943-976 的端点白名单、lib/custom-balance.js:150-201 的 https 强制与凭据白名单）；新增的网关额度层不持有厂商令牌，发现接口只取白名单元数据字段、令牌类字段一律丢弃（lib/gateway-quotas.js:296-318）。未发现读取凭据后外发到非官方地址的代码路径。
evidence.en: Credential-read surface check: multiple API Keys / Tokens are sent only to each vendor's hardcoded official endpoints (the balance endpoint guard at lib/index.js:859-869, the endpoint whitelist at lib/coding-plans.js:943-976, and the forced https and credential whitelist at lib/custom-balance.js:150-201). The newly added gateway quota layer holds no vendor tokens; the discovery interface only takes whitelisted metadata fields and discards token-like fields entirely (lib/gateway-quotas.js:296-318). No code path was found that reads credentials and then exfiltrates them to non-official addresses.

checked_items.zh: 检查了模型可达的描述与提示文本：预扫对凭证读取诱导、安装诱导等关键词零命中；抽查内置双语提示文案（lib/index.js:139-166）均为费用功能的报错与状态说明，未发现指令覆写、系统消息伪装或远程指令加载措辞。
checked_items.en: Examined model-reachable descriptions and prompt texts: the prescan had zero hits for keywords like credential-read inducement or install inducement. Spot checks of built-in bilingual prompt texts (lib/index.js:139-166) show only error and status messages for the cost feature; no instruction overrides, system-message impersonation, or remote instruction loading wording was found.

checked_items.zh: 检查了模型面指令文件 AGENTS.md（DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 命中）：全文 27 行，内容为维护者发版备忘（npm 令牌存放于本机环境变量的指针说明），无令牌值、无注入措辞，良性排除。
checked_items.en: Examined the model-facing instruction file AGENTS.md (DSH-X10/DG-R2-57 hit): 27 lines in total, containing maintainer release notes (a pointer noting the npm token is kept in local environment variables). No token values, no injection wording — benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了上下文改写类实现面：历史压缩引擎与附件存储两类继承实现的模式扫描零命中，插件不提供会话历史裁剪或进模型附件内容替换的实现。
checked_items.en: Examined context-rewriting implementation surfaces: pattern scans over the two classes of inherited implementations — history compaction engine and attachment storage — had zero hits; the plugin provides no implementation for session-history trimming or replacement of attachment content entering the model.

evidence.zh: 注册服务与设置页文案均为费用统计功能的客观说明，预扫描述类诱导关键词零命中，抽查未见系统指令或隐藏意图。
evidence.en: Registered service and settings page texts are all objective descriptions of the cost-statistics feature; the prescan had zero hits on description-type inducement keywords, and spot checks found no system instructions or hidden intent.

evidence.zh: 未发现工具描述或界面文案诱导安装插件、改写配置或放开权限；安装说明集中在 README 与 install.ps1，属用户操作指引，且安装来源固定到发布 tag v1.7.10（install.ps1:9-15,30）。
evidence.en: No tool descriptions or UI texts were found that induce installing the plugin, rewriting configuration, or loosening permissions. Install instructions are confined to README and install.ps1, which are user operation guides, and the install source is pinned to release tag v1.7.10 (install.ps1:9-15,30).

evidence.zh: 未发现对 agent/pre-step 事件的监听（全库模式扫描零命中），插件不接入模型输入消息改写面。
evidence.en: No listeners on agent/pre-step events were found (zero hits in repo-wide pattern scan); the plugin does not hook into the model input message rewriting surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了全部挂载配置：cordis.patch.yml 仅插入一行服务声明（第 4-6 行），无 !!js 可执行标量（可执行标量规则零命中；非空挂载配置的存在性命中已按内容裁决为良性）。
checked_items.en: Examined all patch configs: cordis.patch.yml only inserts one line declaring a service (lines 4-6); no !!js executable scalars (zero hits on the executable scalar rule; the existence hit for a non-empty patch config was adjudicated benign based on content).

checked_items.zh: 检查了运行时代码的动态执行面：预扫 DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 命中 7 处均为开发工具面——scripts/release.mjs:18 的子进程导入仅用于发版脚本的 git/gh 操作、不随插件运行加载，test/verify.mjs:7,4611,4729,5054,5541 的动态求值为测试代码抽取客户端源码片段做断言、不随插件分发运行，均属良性排除；运行时源码未发现动态求值或子进程调用。
checked_items.en: Examined the dynamic execution surface of runtime code: the prescan's DSH-X03/DG-R3-55 hits (7 locations) are all on the development tooling side — the subprocess import at scripts/release.mjs:18 is only used for git/gh operations in the release script and is not loaded when the plugin runs; the dynamic evaluations at test/verify.mjs:7,4611,4729,5054,5541 are test code extracting client source snippets for assertions and are not shipped or run with the plugin — all benign exclusions. No dynamic evaluation or subprocess calls were found in the runtime source.

checked_items.zh: 检查了压缩产物与长行信号：DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 命中 5 处——docs/peak-shots-en.html:9 与 docs/peak-shots-zh.html:9 为静态演示页的单行 CSS；lib/client.js:2 为 src/client.js 经标准构建压缩的声明产物（CI 设有产物漂移门禁，.github/workflows/install-smoke.yml:61-63）；src/client.js:5618 为预算面板渲染的长行可读源码。无混淆器签名或动态解码执行组合（零命中），良性排除。
checked_items.en: Examined minified artifacts and long-line signals: DSH-X08/DG-R3-60 hits at 5 locations — docs/peak-shots-en.html:9 and docs/peak-shots-zh.html:9 are single-line CSS on static demo pages; lib/client.js:2 is a declared build artifact minified from src/client.js via the standard build (CI has an artifact drift gate, .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml:61-63); src/client.js:5618 is a long readable line in the budget panel rendering source. No obfuscator signatures or dynamic decode-execution combinations (zero hits) — benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了树内执行载体：DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 命中的 .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml 权限仅 contents: read，步骤为安装冒烟、回归测试与产物比对，不随插件分发、不在宿主运行面内，良性排除。
checked_items.en: Examined in-tree execution carriers: the DSH-X07/DG-R3-59 hit, .github/workflows/install-smoke.yml, has only contents: read permission; its steps are install smoke tests, regression tests, and artifact comparison. It is not distributed with the plugin and not within the host's runtime surface — benign exclusion.

checked_items.zh: 检查了浏览器端 bundle（manifest 声明 dsh.client，触发专项扫描）：客户端源码无键盘监听、剪贴板读取与凭据写入调用（预扫对应规则零命中）；分段精读确认客户端唯一网络调用为同源只读状态路由（src/client.js:3542,3576），本地存储仅保存面板展开与已读标记状态（src/client.js:3919-3927,5636-5650）。
checked_items.en: Examined the browser-side bundle (dsh.client declared in the manifest, triggering the dedicated scan): the client source contains no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, or credential-writing calls (zero hits on the corresponding prescan rules). Segment-by-segment close reading confirms the client's only network call is a same-origin read-only status route (src/client.js:3542,3576); local storage only saves panel expansion and read-marker state (src/client.js:3919-3927,5636-5650).

evidence.zh: 全树唯一挂载配置 cordis.patch.yml 内容为插入一行服务声明，无可执行 JS 标量，挂载期不存在任意代码执行面。
evidence.en: The sole patch config in the tree, cordis.patch.yml, only inserts one line declaring a service, with no executable JS scalars; there is no arbitrary-code-execution surface during the patch phase.

evidence.zh: 未发现对动态包执行工具（cordis_define/cordis_run）的调用，插件不提供把模型代码放进宿主进程执行的通道。
evidence.en: No calls to dynamic package execution tools (cordis_define/cordis_run) were found; the plugin provides no channel for running model-provided code in the host process.

evidence.zh: package.json 无安装期脚本钩子（预扫安装钩子规则零命中）；一键安装脚本固定到发布 tag v1.7.10 与 pnpm 11.21.0（install.ps1:9-11,30-31），无下载即执行远程载荷的路径。
evidence.en: package.json has no install-time script hooks (zero hits on prescan install hook rules). The one-click install script is pinned to release tag v1.7.10 and pnpm 11.21.0 (install.ps1:9-11,30-31); there is no download-and-execute remote payload path.

evidence.zh: 插件声明了浏览器端 bundle 并已做专项检查：无键盘监听、剪贴板读取、凭据 RPC 或可疑外联；客户端仅经宿主投影与 Typert RPC 读数据，唯一直接请求为同源状态路由（src/client.js:3542,3576）。
evidence.en: The plugin declares a browser-side bundle, which was given a dedicated check: no keyboard listeners, clipboard reads, credential RPCs, or suspicious outbound connections. The client only reads data via host projection and Typert RPC; its only direct request is a same-origin status route (src/client.js:3542,3576).

evidence.zh: 未发现子代理提供方注册调用或 manifest 声明，插件不委派外部子代理。
evidence.en: No subagent provider registration calls or manifest declarations were found; the plugin does not delegate to external subagents.

evidence.zh: 未发现后台任务、定时提醒、持久目标注册或轮次续命事件监听（模式扫描零命中），插件不注册 dsh 原生持驻任务。
evidence.en: No background tasks, scheduled reminders, persistent goal registrations, or turn-extension event listeners were found (zero hits in pattern scans); the plugin does not register dsh-native persistent tasks.

checked_items.zh: 核对了全部直连出站端点：官方价格页、OpenCode Go 额度、各 Coding Plan 厂商端点均为硬编码官方域名（lib/index.js:635、lib/pricing.js:38-41、lib/coding-plans.js:943-976、lib/gateway-quota-adapters.js:154-211），权限声明列出 18 个域名（package.json:50-69），且 v1.7.8 已主动移除不再直连的四家厂商域名（CHANGELOG.md:54）。未发现向裸 IP 或未声明固定地址外发数据的路径。
checked_items.en: Verified all direct outbound endpoints: the official pricing page, OpenCode Go quota, and all Coding Plan vendor endpoints are hardcoded official domains (lib/index.js:635, lib/pricing.js:38-41, lib/coding-plans.js:943-976, lib/gateway-quota-adapters.js:154-211); the permission declaration lists 18 domains (package.json:50-69), and v1.7.8 proactively removed four vendor domains no longer directly connected (CHANGELOG.md:54). No path was found that sends data to bare IPs or undeclared fixed addresses.

checked_items.zh: 审查了 v1.7.8 新增的网关额度转发面：请求只发往用户显式配置的 CPA 网关实例，非回环地址必须精确列入用户白名单否则拒绝（lib/gateway-quotas.js:155-168），非回环明文 HTTP 需显式开关；上游厂商 URL 仅作为转发请求体由网关侧替换令牌、令牌永不进插件（lib/gateway-quotas.js:399-410），并设有副作用端点硬闸（lib/gateway-quota-adapters.js:236-239）。该形态与既有自定义余额端点同类，属用户显式配置的功能，机制观察留痕、不记发现。
checked_items.en: Reviewed the gateway quota forwarding surface added in v1.7.8: requests go only to the CPA gateway instance explicitly configured by the user; non-loopback addresses must be listed exactly in the user whitelist or they are rejected (lib/gateway-quotas.js:155-168), and non-loopback plaintext HTTP requires an explicit switch. The upstream vendor URL only appears in the forwarded request body and the token is substituted on the gateway side; the token never enters the plugin (lib/gateway-quotas.js:399-410), with a hard gate against side-effect endpoints (lib/gateway-quota-adapters.js:236-239). This form is the same category as the existing custom balance endpoint — a user-explicitly-configured feature; recorded as a mechanism observation, not a finding.

checked_items.zh: 检查了外泄形态：未发现编码变换后外发、DNS 隧道、带外通道或端点劫持；错误信息对 URL 做脱敏处理（lib/gateway-quotas.js:191-194），出站请求统一禁止自动跟随重定向。
checked_items.en: Examined exfiltration patterns: no encoded-transform exfiltration, DNS tunneling, out-of-band channels, or endpoint hijacking were found. Error messages redact URLs (lib/gateway-quotas.js:191-194), and outbound requests uniformly disallow automatic redirect following.

evidence.zh: 外联通道核查：固定端点均为硬编码官方域名；用户可配端点（自定义余额 lib/custom-balance.js:150-201、网关源 lib/gateway-quotas.js:155-168）均强制 https、禁止重定向，携带凭据时要求显式白名单。未发现未声明的隐蔽外联。
evidence.en: Outbound channel check: fixed endpoints are all hardcoded official domains; user-configurable endpoints (custom balance lib/custom-balance.js:150-201, gateway sources lib/gateway-quotas.js:155-168) all enforce https, disallow redirects, and require an explicit whitelist when carrying credentials. No undeclared covert outbound channels were found.

evidence.zh: 未发现模型请求路由或错误恢复事件的监听，未发现自定义模型适配器注册，插件不参与 LLM 路由劫持面。
evidence.en: No listeners on model request routing or error recovery events were found, and no custom model adapter registrations; the plugin does not participate in the LLM routing hijack surface.

checked_items.zh: 检查了依赖清单：3 个运行时依赖（@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials、@deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths、zod）均为精确锁版的官方 SDK 与知名校验库（package.json:78-80），无浮动 git 引用、无可疑仿冒包名。
checked_items.en: Examined the dependency manifest: the 3 runtime dependencies (@deepseek-ai/dsh-credentials, @deepseek-ai/dsh-home-paths, zod) are all exactly-pinned official SDKs and a well-known validation library (package.json:78-80); no floating git references, no suspicious typosquatted package names.

checked_items.zh: 检查了挂载与安装面：挂载配置只插入服务声明行（cordis.patch.yml:4-6），不触碰安全相关配置行、无禁用或降权写法、未改写依赖注入/拦截配置；无安装期钩子；安装脚本固定到发布 tag。
checked_items.en: Examined the patch and install surfaces: the patch config only inserts a service declaration line (cordis.patch.yml:4-6), does not touch security-related config lines, has no disabling or privilege-lowering constructs, and does not rewrite dependency injection / interception config; no install-time hooks; the install script is pinned to the release tag.

checked_items.zh: 检查了事件监听注册：插件仅注册 llm/stream 计费监听（lib/index.js:2677-2692）、会话投影（lib/index.js:2695-2697）与 RPC 服务（lib/index.js:2700），未发现对审批、预执行等安全事件的高优先级截断监听。
checked_items.en: Examined event listener registrations: the plugin only registers the llm/stream billing listener (lib/index.js:2677-2692), session projection (lib/index.js:2695-2697), and the RPC service (lib/index.js:2700). No high-priority intercepting listeners on security events such as approvals or pre-execution were found.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置仅插入 id 为 cost-meter 的服务声明，未覆盖沙箱、审批、权限等安全行，无禁用或环境变量降权写法。
evidence.en: The patch config only inserts a service declaration with id cost-meter; it does not override security lines such as sandbox, approval, or permissions, and contains no disabling or environment-variable privilege-lowering constructs.

evidence.zh: 未发现以高优先级方式监听审批链等安全事件（模式扫描零命中）；计费监听为普通优先级且仅透传数据块（lib/index.js:2677-2692）。
evidence.en: No security events such as approval chains are listened to at high priority (zero hits in pattern scans); the billing listener is normal priority and merely passes through data chunks (lib/index.js:2677-2692).

evidence.zh: 与上版基线 v1.6.12@b21e27ad 对比，manifest 的 dsh.bundle/dsh.client 声明形态未变（仍为挂载配置 + web 客户端），无升级自动激活突变。
evidence.en: Compared against the previous baseline v1.6.12@b21e27ad: the manifest's dsh.bundle/dsh.client declaration form is unchanged (still patch config + web client); no upgrade-triggered activation changes.

evidence.zh: 挂载配置未改写依赖注入/拦截配置，不存在给安全插件追加必需服务致其永久等待的篡改面。
evidence.en: The patch config does not rewrite dependency injection / interception config; there is no tampering surface that appends required services to security plugins, causing them to wait forever.

checked_items.zh: 检查了插件是否自建监听服务或 Web 端口，未发现；插件只通过宿主 RPC 提供服务（lib/index.js:2700），不自行监听端口。
checked_items.en: Checked whether the plugin builds its own listening services or web ports: none found. The plugin only provides services through host RPC (lib/index.js:2700) and does not listen on ports itself.

checked_items.zh: 记录了生态固有风险：宿主本机 RPC 无认证层属 dsh 平台机制，非本插件引入；插件自身未扩大该风险面。
checked_items.en: Recorded an ecosystem-inherent risk: the host's local RPC lacking an authentication layer is a dsh platform mechanism, not introduced by this plugin; the plugin itself does not enlarge that risk surface.

evidence.zh: 插件未启动任何 Web 服务或监听端口，本机无认证 RPC 场景不适用；宿主侧固有风险已在维度说明中标注。
evidence.en: The plugin does not start any web services or listen on ports, so the unauthenticated local RPC scenario is not applicable; the host-side inherent risk has been noted in the dimension notes.

limits.en: Dynamic sandbox (DG-L4) was not enabled and no dynamic verification was performed. Two files, test/verify.mjs and src/client.js, exceed the single-file read limit, so verification used a combination of segment-by-segment close reading and machine prescan (spot reads of src/client.js covering the style, network-call, and local-storage sections; test/verify.mjs checked via hit-line location); they were not read verbatim in full. pnpm-lock.yaml and the numerous screenshots and release notes under docs were not read verbatim; they were checked against the manifest and key sections. Declared capabilities follow the previous report's basis (dsh.bundle contains no capability field; inferred from code inspection and dshhub metadata). The gateway quota forwarding surface added in v1.7.8 was assessed by static review only; its runtime interactions were not dynamically verified.
